name: RBQ-3
def: Electric quadruped from the Korean maker of the HUBO humanoids, sold as a platform for research and field inspection.
body: Rainbow Robotics, founded in 2011 out of the KAIST HUBO laboratory, developed the RBQ series as its legged mobile platform line. RBQ-3 has twelve electric joints, onboard balance control and a software development kit, and is offered with camera and lidar options for navigation research and inspection work. The company has since scaled the design up in the larger RBQ-10 and has worked with Hyundai Rotem on a multi legged robot for defence use.
facts: Built by the KAIST spin off behind the HUBO humanoid robots
Basis of the larger RBQ-10 and of a defence quadruped studied with Hyundai Rotem
specs: Electric joint actuators, three per leg
Inertial measurement unit, optional cameras and lidar
Onboard balance and gait control with a development kit
